title: Quorum reads, writes and read repair
summary: Build a Dynamo-style coordinator over N versioned replicas that needs W acks per write and R answers per read, and repairs the stale replicas it reads from.
hints: A write is a success or failure judged by counting acknowledgements, not by whether every replica got it. A read trusts the highest version among the replicas it asked, so a single up-to-date replica in the read set is enough.

Give every replica one rule for storing: keep the incoming (version, value) only if its version is higher than what it holds. Write, read repair and late old writes then all go through that one function.

write: store on every up replica, count them, raise if the count is below W (without undoing anything). read: take the first R up replicas from the order, raise if there are fewer, pick the answer with the highest version, then store it on each contacted replica whose answer was missing or older.
